teaser: Nine in the morning and already you've claimed the room before anyone else arrives to claim it. Life path 1 and ESFP make an odd kind of leader: one who wants to be out front but also wants everyone laughing along the way. The 1 pushes toward standing alone, deciding alone, being first. ESFP pulls toward the crowd, the room's mood, the shared moment. You lead by being the most alive person in the building, not the quietest one in charge.
